issues.title: Fresh launcher-owned native mission evidence cannot run without SC2
issues.detail: The source map exists, but the launcher-configured SC2 root E:/SC2/SC2new/StarCraft II, three common alternate SC2 roots, and the configured SC2_x64.exe are absent. No SC2_x64.exe process is running. Therefore no compliant launcher/API/runtime listener/ScriptError window can be started.
issues.nextAction: Restore a supported SC2 installation at the launcher-configured root or make a separately scoped launcher configuration change, then rerun Stage 31 with a fresh epoch.
